ov: على كف عفريت (الفرنسية: La Belle et la Meute) هو فيلم دراما فرنسي-تونسي من إنتاج عام 2017 وكتابة إخراج كوثر بن هنية. عرض الفيلم في قسم جائزة نظرة ما في مهرجان كان السينمائي 2017.
plotEn: A young Tunisian woman is raped by police officers and seeks assistance in hospitals and police stations to register their crime while she is still under shock from the attack. She encounters indifference, hostility, bureaucratic impediments and some assistance from the various individuals that she interacts with. In the final scene, several police officers seek to intimidate the victim until one of the officers breaks from the group and encourages the victim to move ahead with her complaint. Based on a true story.
